support_claim: The packet associates the billing name Meridian Energy Partners LLC with contract MSA-MER-2024, but provides no establishing identity evidence (such as a shared licensed legal identifier or an explicit same-entity assertion), so neither SAME_ENTITY nor DISTINCT is warranted.

steps.fact: The left referent is billing:Meridian Energy Partners LLC and the right referent is contract:MSA-MER-2024.
The billing record lists billed_name Meridian Energy Partners LLC.
Contract MSA-MER-2024 lists Counterparty: Meridian Energy Partners LLC.
Commercial notes state that Meridian Energy Partners invoices are the advisory retainer under MSA-MER-2024.
The packet provides no shared legal identifier, no statement that the referents denote the same legal counterparty, and no uniqueness license for any identifier.
Shared name text and operational association between billing records and the contract are insufficient to establish identity under the grounding contract.
The packet provides no evidence establishing that billing:Meridian Energy Partners LLC and contract:MSA-MER-2024 are distinct legal counterparties.
